passage.text: The River View Hotel in Chiang Mai has a lot of reviews online.
passage.reading: ðə ˈrɪvər ˈvjuː hoʊˈtɛl ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ ˈhæz ə ˈlɑːt əv rɪˈvjuːz ˌɑːnˈlaɪn.

passage.text: But two guests had very different stays.
passage.reading: bʌt ˈtuː ˈɡɛsts ˈhæd ˈvɛri ˈdɪfərənt ˈsteɪz.

passage.text: Anna from England stayed there in December.
passage.reading: ˈænə frəm ˈɪŋɡlənd ˈsteɪd ˈðɛr ɪn dɪˈsɛmbər.

passage.text: "The staff were very helpful, and my room was clean and quiet," she says.
passage.reading: ðə ˈstæf wɜːr ˈvɛri ˈhɛlpfəl, ənd maɪ ˈruːm wʌz ˈkliːn ənd ˈkwaɪət, ʃiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "The rooftop pool was amazing, and the breakfast buffet was great value for money."
passage.reading: ðə ˈruːftɑːp ˈpuːl wʌz əˈmeɪzɪŋ, ənd ðə ˈbrɛkfəst bəˈfeɪ wʌz ˈɡreɪt ˈvæljuː fər ˈmʌni.

passage.text: Paul from America stayed there in April, in the hot season.
passage.reading: ˈpɔːl frəm əˈmɛrɪkə ˈsteɪd ˈðɛr ɪn ˈeɪprəl, ɪn ðə ˈhɑːt ˌsiːzən.

passage.text: "The air conditioning in my room was out of order for two days," he says.
passage.reading: ði ˈɛr kənˌdɪʃənɪŋ ɪn maɪ ˈruːm wʌz ˈaʊt əv ˈɔːrdər fər ˈtuː ˈdeɪz, hiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "One man at reception was rude to me, and no one fixed the problem."
passage.reading: ˈwʌn ˈmæn ət rɪˈsɛpʃən wʌz ˈruːd tə miː, ənd ˈnoʊ ˌwʌn ˈfɪkst ðə ˈprɑːbləm.

passage.text: "This hotel isn't good value for money in the hot season!"
passage.reading: ðɪs hoʊˈtɛl ˈɪzənt ˈɡʊd ˈvæljuː fər ˈmʌni ɪn ðə ˈhɑːt ˌsiːzən!
